text:
olivia: deploybot kicked off canary for kernel-quant v3.12.qb1 on night-bucket. seeing early perf blips from matmul path. @raj @maria can we decide pin/rollback thresholds?

deploybot: canary started -> targets=20 hosts, traffic=1%, canary_id=cb-1755012345, started_by=olivia

raj: what metric is flapping? p50/p95/p99? cpu or gpu stalls?

maria: quick snapshot from the smoke stream:
```
baseline p99_token_latency: 38ms
canary p99_token_latency: 41.4ms (+9.2% on matmul-heavy requests)
p50 ~ unchanged (12.1ms -> 12.3ms)
error rate 0.03% (no spike)
```

olivia: thanks — p99 up ~9% but no error spike. wonder if it's an outlier in a single kernel path. i can extend canary to 3% for 30m to get more samples, unless someone wants immediate pin/rollback.

tim: i'd avoid immediate rollback until we validate. suggestion: extend to 3% and run the synthetic matmul stress job against canary hosts. if p99 delta >5% across hosts, rollback. otherwise proceed.

raj: agree. add a safety pin in case of noisy telemetry. deploybot, can you apply a temporary pin with ttl so we don't accidentally cut over full release while we're investigating? command below.

deploybot: `pin set engine kernel-quant:v3.12.qb1 --ttl 2h --reason "investigating p99 matmul +9%"`

maria: starting synthetic perf now, grabbing GPU traces and per-kernel histograms. i'll post logs once done.

olivia: extended canary to 3% for 30m. watch the canary_id cb-1755012345. i'll update release-notes blurb in the doc while we wait. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploybot: canary traffic increased -> 3% (applied by olivia). pin applied: kernel-quant:v3.12.qb1 ttl=2h. will auto-unpin at ttl expiry unless renewed.

tim: perfect. if synthetic confirms narrow-host regressions we can roll a quick micropatch. if it's systemic, we'll trigger rollback criteria (>5% p99 across 50% of canary hosts) and follow rollback playbook.

olivia: acknowledged. monitoring. will reconvene in 25m with synthetic results. :white_check_mark:
